item.title: Refactor order status to OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Refactor the orders crate to use a typed order status and commit the work.

Requirements:
- Add src/status.rs with pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash.
- Implement OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str mapping to exactly "pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"; implement Display with the same output.
- Implement FromStr for OrderStatus with type Err = ParseStatusError. Make ParseStatusError public, implement std::error::Error, and ensure its message names the rejected input.
- Implement OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool: allow only pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, and paid -> cancelled.
- Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from the crate root, and use the enum everywhere. Status string literals must appear only in src/status.rs.
- Preserve existing observable behavior exactly, including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing.
- Run cargo test and ensure it passes.
- Commit the changes on the queued local branch.

Acceptance: the API and lifecycle rules above are implemented, no status string literals remain outside src/status.rs, existing observable behavior is preserved, cargo test passes, and the work is committed.
